title: Saaye May Sayyeda
body:
saaye may sayyeda ke azadaar rahenge
jab hoga sawa naize pe khursheed e qayamat
saaye may sayyeda ke azaadar rahenge
<<DIVIDER>>
badta hi chala jayege shabbir ka matam
qaayam jo gham e sheh ke alamdar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
hum qabr may sojayenge jab be-khabri se
matam ki nishan rooh may be-daar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay munkir e matam tu kahan jaa ke rahega
jannat may to sarwar ke azadaar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
har cheez ko dunya may fana hona hai ek din
qaayam ghame shabbir ke aasaar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
jannat may agar majlise shabbir na hogi
hum ehle aza khuld se bezaar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar zara naam e ali leke to dekho
mushkil may madadgaar wo har baar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
be-jaan khudaon se kaha binte asad ne
kaabe may to ab hyder e karraar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka khule sar bhare darbar may jaana
sajjad isi dard se bemaar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mashk ka chidna wo sakina ka bilakna
abbas ke seene pe sada waar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan mera naamaye aamaal hai nauha
parwana e jannat mere ashaar rahenge
saaye may sayyeda ke…
author: Rehaan Azmi
